name: G1yphd3c0de-Bench
description: G1yphd3c0de-Bench evaluates models' ability to decode and normalize stylized or obfuscated glyph/text representations into canonical text. It measures robustness to nonstandard orthography and symbol substitutions across varied inputs. Tasks require precise, often token-level decoding rather than broad semantic summarization.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among robustness and cipher-decoding researchers.
